info.name: HW06 · 23127195 · API-1 (FR-04) — Quan ly ho so ca nhan (Personal Profile Management)
info.description:
HW06 - 23127195 - API-1 (Pool A, FR-04).

Phu: domain partition tren 3 tham so (name, phone, shipping_address), state transition (vong doi phien + tinh nhat quan ghi/doc + partial update), security SEC-01/SEC-02/SEC-05/SEC-06 (leo quyen qua truong role), va schema validation.

Sinh tu testcases/api1_fr04_testcases.json bang postman/scripts/build_collections.py.
